title: Everyday Structures
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Everyday Structures Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe structures in the environment, both natural and made by people; describe how structures support or protect; build and test simple structures. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand D: Structures and Mechanisms – Materials, Objects, and Everyday Structures)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on natural and human-made structures, shelters and building with blocks, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A structure holds or supports something.
key_sub: Nests, houses, tables and bridges are structures.
body_html:
How to think about it

A structure is something built to hold, support or protect.

  • Animals build nests, webs and dams.
  • People build houses, bridges and slides.
  • A wide bottom keeps a tower standing.
Example

Is a nest a structure?

a bird built it to hold eggs

Answer: yes

Example

Which tower stands best?

wide bottom

Answer: the wide one

Common mistakes

  • Thinking only big buildings are structures.
  • Thinking a tall, thin tower is the most stable.
